meta.name: cloud
meta.description: Create cloud provider architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with official AWS, Azure, GCP, and Alibaba Cloud service icons. Best for multi-service cloud topologies and migration blueprints.

copy.tagline_en: Draw cloud architecture diagrams with PlantUML
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create multi-service cloud topology diagrams

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成云架构图（如 AWS、Azure、GCP 等），使用 PlantUML 语法和官方图标。你只需用代码块包裹指令，Claude 就会输出可渲染的图表代码。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制云架构图，或描述多服务拓扑、迁移蓝图时触发。需要以 ```plantuml 或 ```puml 代码块开头。

say.text: 用 Azure 图标画一个包含负载均衡器和虚拟机的架构。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Azure 的 stencil 图标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate cloud architecture diagrams (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) using PlantUML syntax with official service icons. You describe the topology, and Claude outputs renderable diagram code inside a code fence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a cloud architecture diagram, multi-service topology, or migration blueprint. Must start with ```plantuml or ```puml code fence.

say_en.text: Draw an AWS architecture: users via CloudFront to EC2, EC2 to RDS.
say_en.note: Claude generates the corresponding PlantUML code.

say_en.text: Draw an Azure architecture with a load balancer and virtual machines.
Draw a GCP log processing flow from Cloud Monitoring to Compute Engine.
say_en.note: Claude generates a GCP architecture diagram.
